title: Represent SRD services, expenses, food, lodging, and spellcasting service tables
description:
Problem
The SRD contains mechanically relevant lifestyle, service, and expense tables that are not adequately represented in the imported pack.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Unrepresented source content includes pages 73-74:
- Food, Drink, and Lodging
- Services
- Spellcasting Services
- Related cost tables

Required behavior
- Import these sections as rule, table, equipment, service, or another explicitly chosen record type.
- Costs, units, and service names should be preserved in structured form where feasible.
- Spellcasting services should be retrievable as rules data rather than lost prose.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
notes: Scope note from eshyra-0m9.23 (PR #185): the source tables Standard Exchange Rates (p62), Trade Goods (p72), Lifestyle Expenses (p72-73), Food/Drink/Lodging (p73-74), and Services (p74) are now registered in SRD_5_1_SOURCE_TABLE_GAPS (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceCoverage.ts) and surface as missing-coverage audit findings. Exchange Rates / Trade Goods / Lifestyle Expenses are clean 2/6-column tables. Food/Drink/Lodging and Services are NESTED grouped tables (group-header rows like 'Ale'/'Coach cab' with indented sub-item rows) needing a column/sub-row representation decision before a faithful flat-row import. Implement these as table records (or structured fields) here.
